name: ui-evidence
description: Capture and publish screenshots or video that prove a UI change — accurate shell and commit, permanent URLs for the PR body.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshots and video proving a UI change, published for the PR.
interface.longDescription: Rules for capturing UI evidence on any accurate route — right shell, right commit, viewport and teardown gotchas — with an un-capturable convention so shots never quietly go missing, published via pr-media-upload.
